           Rescinds:      OPPNs 3/87, 7/87, 21/87, 4/88, 2/89, 3/89, 9/89, 19/90, 25/90, 13/91, 15/91, 17/91, 18/91, 25/92,

                          First Deputy Commissioner

     Issuance Date:       June 23, 2017

            Purpose:      This bulletin rescinds 22 Operational Policy and Procedure Notices (OPPNs) that are no
                          longer applicable under any Code.

          Subject(s):     OPPNs, Rescinded


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

Provided above is a list of 22 OPPNs to be rescinded, effective immediately.

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. These
documents will appear on the Department website with the watermark RESCINDED.

Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in future
bulletins.

Watermarked BBs and PPNs may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at
http://www1.nyc.gov/site/buildings/codes/building-bulletins.page.
